thread:
mina: Quick heads-up — after the q4_kv quant bring-up for orion-v2 I'm seeing detokenization regressions in vertical Japanese + mixed RTL/CJK snippets. Low-effort repro attached below.

cheng: Can you paste an input -> output example so I can run locally?

mina: Yep — minimal example: 

```
INPUT (vertical furigana + ZWJ):
漢字
{ruby: 漢字|furigana: かんじ}

BASELINE DETOK:
漢字
{ruby: 漢字|furigana: かんじ}

Q4_KV DETOK (bad):
漢字
{ruby: 漢字|furigana: かんじ}
# note: U+E010 (variation selector) lost and ruby marker shifted to next line
```

eli: That looks like ZWJ/variation selector handling being stripped during detok or during tokenizer normalization. Could be a tokenization-normalize step introduced in the new commit.

rachel: I did a quick bisect — commit 0f3a6ea in tokenizer-normalize touches vertical-mode normalization and changes how we collapse Joiners (PR #842). Repro steps I used: 

```bash
# run the detok smoke harness
./scripts/eval_smoke.sh --model orion-v2-q4 --subset vertical_ja --runs 3
# or run interactive detok check
python -m rdl.eval detok --model orion-v2-q4 --input samples/vertical_ja.txt --out /tmp/out.txt
```

mina: High-level numbers from the smoke run: 
- BLEU (vertical_ja): baseline (float32) 34.6 -> q4_kv 30.9 (delta -3.7)
- Perplexity (shortctx): baseline 12.1 -> q4 14.8
- Embed cosine drift (en-zh dev): 0.013 (not huge but noticeable)

eli: If bisect points to tokenizer commit then quantization probably just exposed the latent bug. Suggest we run detok with legacy normalization flag to confirm.

cheng: Running legacy flag now on a small shard, will post results. @rachel can you prepare the candidate hotfix branch if that confirms?

eval-bot: Job 382914 started: smoke/detok/orion-v2-q4 (shard 7). URL: https://ci.internal/382914 — status: running

mina: Quick local check with legacy normalization: `python -m rdl.eval detok --model orion-v2-q4 --input samples/vertical_ja.txt --legacy-zwj` -> output matches baseline (variation selectors preserved).

eval-bot: Job 382914 finished — status: success. Key metric: BLEU delta vs baseline = -0.1 for legacy flag run.

rachel: OK — plan: 1) revert the vertical-mode joiner collapse in tokenizer-normalize (hotfix branch), 2) add a focused regression test with ruby/furigana + ZWJ cases, 3) re-run full quant pipeline and smoke suite.

eli: Also add an integration test in the quant CI that runs detok on a small vertical JA sample after kernel selection — we shouldn't assume quantization will hide normalization issues.

mina: Will open a PR with failing test + repro data (samples/vertical_ja.txt) and link to the CI job. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

cheng: Thanks — leaving the shard results in /artifacts/382914.

rachel: assigning myself to the hotfix, will ping when PR is up.
